facts.fact: 马塞尔·普鲁斯特（Marcel Proust）作为伯爵夫人周日沙龙的常客，固定坐在 2 rue Bassano 宅邸那张无扶手的 chaise chauffeuse 长椅上观察宾客；据 Alice 1962 年对 Le Figaro 记者的回忆，他每周日坐下、环顾四周却一言不发。
facts.quote: Marcel Proust occupied his habitual post in a low, armless chaise chauffeuse, his eyes fixed on the guests at the Cahen d’Anvers mansion at 2 rue Bassano.

facts.fact: Louise Cahen d’Anvers 把「打开 rue Bassano 的橡木大门、用音乐家/作家/女演员与出色谈话者待客」当作一个犹太女性向上进入 le Monde 的最有效策略，并以此主持她的每周沙龙。
facts.quote: the most effective strategy for a Jewish woman like Louise Cahen d’Anvers was to open her massive oaken doors on rue Bassano to entertain through musicians, writers, actresses, or brilliant conversationalists

facts.fact: Louise 从 Irène 约 12 岁起就开始把她塑造成自己的翻版：训练从上紧绳、鲸骨（baleen）与刺绣束腹开始，要求她只能滑行、不能奔跑、不能多吃、不能大笑。
facts.quote: The shaping of Irène to be like her mother began by the time she was about twelve.

facts.fact: Irène 的外祖父 Meyer Cahen d’Anvers 于 1881 年被安葬在 Montmartre 一座奢华的石灰岩陵墓中；历史学家据葬礼与墓地花费判定，只有最上层 27% 的中上产家庭买得起体面坟墓。
facts.quote: the opulent limestone mausoleum in Montmartre where Irène’s grandfather, Meyer Cahen d’Anvers, was buried in 1881.

facts.fact: Jean Béraud 在 1878 年画出 Une Soirée（本章题名所本），把 Louise 画进煤气灯下的真实舞会：冰蓝礼服、钻石领口、挽着一位俄国大使；该画在巴黎沙龙展出后，L’Illustration 的评论者认定它是对上流社会的讽刺。
facts.quote: In 1878, the financial aristocracy from the Right Bank was forever immortalized in Une Soirée, a Jean Béraud painting of a gaslit Parisian ball of real people that slyly captured the social codes.

facts.fact: Charles Ephrussi 1905 年 56 岁时死于糖尿病，遗嘱只留给 Louise 三颗白色天然海珍珠（估价 800 法郎，今值约 $5,700），没有任何解释。
facts.quote: When Ephrussi died in 1905 at the age of fifty-six, of diabetes, in his will he left Louise just three exceptional white natural saltwater pearls.

facts.fact: Louise 的第五个也是最小的孩子 Charles 于 1879 年出生，其法国出生证明明确把他登记为 Louis Cahen d’Anvers 的婚生子；但家族几十年后仍在议论他与 Ephrussi 的「影子父亲」传闻。
facts.quote: This despite the fact that Charles’s 1879 French birth certificate clearly listed him as the legitimate son of Louis Cahen d’Anvers.

facts.fact: 本章收尾：Goncourt 偷听到 Louise 对一桩包办婚姻的判断——素未谋面的新娘要在丈夫脱掉衬衫那一刻才「解开道德之谜」，即婚姻是为财产与门第而安排，女性被训练接受这一点。
facts.quote: according to Goncourt, Louise said it: “The young girl marrying a man she doesn’t know at all will suddenly—completely and all at once—figure out the moral enigma the moment he is in his shirt, leading her to his bed.”
